claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
Payment terms have been agreed by the VSP.
The VSP has sent the collected claim forms monthly to the MSIU field office.
The MSIU field office has validated the claim form manually and through the system.
Claim collection has occurred for the relevant reporting period for clean claims to be paid without reservation and for claims where payment shall be withheld until clarification.
Based on the payment terms agreed by VSP, the field office will generate Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report and send it to MSIU Admin team to arrange the payments for the VSP.

trigger.raw_text: Based on the payment terms agreed by VSP, the field office will generate Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report and send it to MSIU Admin team to arrange the payments for the VSP.

claims.content: After claim collection, the field office generates the monthly report on clean claims to be paid without reservation.
The field office generates the monthly report on claims where payment shall be withheld until clarification.
The field office generates the report on claims per provider.
Based on the payment terms agreed by VSP, the field office generates Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report.
The field office sends the report to MSIU Admin team to arrange the payments for the VSP.
If any mandatory information is missed or any false information is existing, the field office rejects the claim back to VSP and the system keeps those claims in a quarantine area.
The quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification.
If the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims are entered on to the system in the following month’s batch.

If any mandatory information is missed or any false information is existing, the field office rejects the claim back to VSP and the system keeps the claim in a quarantine area; the quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification. Exit the use case; the claim remains in quarantine pending VSP verification.

If the VSP returns the quarantined claim with satisfactory details, the claim is entered on to the system in the following month’s batch. Exit the use case; the claim is handled in the following month’s batch.
The Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report has been generated based on the payment terms agreed by VSP.
The Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report has been sent to the MSIU Admin team to arrange the payments for the VSP.
The monthly report after claim collection on clean claims to be paid without reservation has been generated.
The monthly report after claim collection on claims, where payment shall be withheld until clarification, has been generated.
The report on claims per provider has been generated.
Reports have been generated from the Database and feed back to the Admin Team.
